notes.title: V1.1 is now out!
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the support so far, it's been incredible!
Version 1.1 contains a few small improvements/additions improvements:
[list]
[*] The game is now available in Brazilian Portuguese!
[*] The fullscreen to windowed toggle is now an option in the options menu (as well as being toggleable with F4 and F11).
[/list]
